draftNote: 3 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane), Goldilocks324 (jungle→midlane), Xeebs (carry→jungle).

coaching.headline: Three lanes were ours, but a string of bad trades fed Legion and Sparrow until the map was gone.
coaching.team: We won the draft — carry, offlane and jungle all read favored — and lost it in the fights: 1-3 at 14, 2-3 at the 15.1 Fangtooth, 0-5 at their Mini Prime at 18.5 and 0-5 at their River at 23. The macro softens three of those: at 14 and 15.1 the offlane was alive and ahead in lane — a shove-and-rotate flips those counts — and Fangtooth was taken in the same windows, so read them as trades, not clean losses. The film flags three of us with no armor into their 4-physical comp and towers ended 1 to their 9; after the 18.5 wipe, reset and defend beats the 23-minute re-engage.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Repeated full-team losses into a fed Legion and Sparrow — the 0-5 wipe at their Mini Prime (18.5) and the 0-5 at their River (23) — with the film flagging three of us for no armor against Legion's 36350 physical.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mourn died 6 times into a comp where Mr_Meat31 and Wraith were getting collapsed on every fight. Mr_Meat31 was dragged into the 18.5 Mini Prime wipe and the 23-min River wipe — both 0-5 losses. As the frontline, the job there was to be the one calling the disengage, not to be first in. When the team can't win a fight, the support stops it.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Crunch was the favored jungler and Goldilocks324 had the early lead, but carried no armor into a 4-physical comp and Legion (36k) punished it every fight. The 6 deaths came in the forced team fights (14, 18.5). The build fix is real here — armor was missing core — but the bigger one is not committing the whole squad into their carries on their half.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Shinbi was favored into Adele and Cuban Noobster barely got to play the lane — 1 kill, appearing at 12.7, 17.5, 18.5 and 23 with the tempo already gone. Get on the map earlier with the lead the matchup handed over; arriving only for the lost team fights wastes a winning matchup.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Wraith had the favored lane but the team comp was 4/5 magical — one enemy magic-resist item blunts most of it; that's the comp flag, and it showed. The Vanquisher only came online around 24 minutes, the end of the game, so Xeebs was under-tuned for the fights that mattered (14, 18.5, 23). Push for objectives the team can actually take instead of walking the full team into Legion's side, where these 5v5s kept going his way.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zinx was the unfavored lane into Sparrow and it was theirs all game. The problem was team-wide: Zinx got pulled into the 14, 18.5 and 23-min wipes. With the lane already behind, Zinx's value is poke and zone, not committing into a fed Legion in the open.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash, Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
ourKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

legion.loadout: Demiurge (Construct), augment Heavy Caliber, crest Epoch
fedBy: Malady (Demise): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage.• Gain a stack of Demise.• Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise.• Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,515 hero damage a minute, more than 92% of Legion carry players this patch (37% of the team's). Penetration did the work: Mourn took about 44% more physical damage than their armor allowed (estimate).
Orbital Sanction at rank 2: 125s base, about 95.4s by the end (24% shorter) from 31 ability haste: Malady 8, The Perforator 15, Epoch 8.
14 takedowns (12 kills, 2 assists) fed: Malady (Demise).
Legion dealt 36,350 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +145 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Vanquisher 12, The Perforator 8, The Perforator ignores 30%; against Mourn (level 13: about 112 physical armor, 47 after penetration; took 21,503 physical damage from heroes, 84% of all hero damage they took) and Wraith (level 13: about 80 physical armor, 25 after penetration; took 12,072 physical damage from heroes, 86% of all hero damage they took) that is about 44% and 44% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Malady (item): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
The Perforator (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 10% for 1s.
Demiurge (Eternal): Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.
Heavy Caliber (augment): Basic Attack Timer is increased to 0.75s, but deal 300% damage and have 100 increased range. Magazine Size is decreased to 6.

Lesson: Legion's penetration cut through: Mourn took about 44% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 13 their armor was about 112, about 47 after 31 flat + 30% penetration).
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Legion killed built physical armor (Mourn). We killed Legion 3 times.
Copy it? Demiurge: 53.4% in 781 Legion carry games, above the hero's 52.2%; this 3-item core: 61.8% in 422 games, above the 57.7% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

amps.how: Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

amps.name: Thraex
amps.how: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

amps.name: Sun Shards
amps.how: Sparrow's basic attacks ricochet 1/2/3/4 times, dealing (+20%) Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 35% effectiveness.

effects.name: Savage Strikes
effects.how: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

lead.title: Healed through fights
lead.text: 169 healing a minute, more than 88% of Sparrow mid players this patch.

members.name: Storm Breaker
members.text: While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets. Deal 70 (+20%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects.

members.name: Sky Splitter
members.text: On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.

members.name: Ashbringer
members.text: On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit. Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes. Only triggers once per ability. Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
